title: Canonical source coefficient unit, associativity and shift equations
statement: Fix the geometric hypotheses, full finite-Tor categories, ordinary derived coefficient extensions and canonical source components of [def-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality-data]. For any proof of scalar closure and any family a of natural isomorphisms whose underlying components are exactly sourceScalarComponent, the source comparisons satisfy the ordinary tensor-unit equation, the displayed three-field tensor-associator equation and compatibility with the specified sourceShift and scalarShift structures. No purity gamma or exceptional comparison b is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the source_identity, source_composition and source_shift clauses of the operation-domain/source-comparison node. Its source component uses K-flat ordinary scalar extension; compare it to the exact-derived ordinary presentation by their universal counits and chi on complete inputs. The beta and pullback normalization equations give precisely sourceScalarComponent. The signed shifts agree by their representative descent normalizations. Full-inclusion faithfulness transports the unit, associator and shift equations, and aCanonical substitutes the given a.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalSourceCoherence (hC : ScalarClosed D C X Y)
    (a : ∀ (E F : Field D C) (h : E ≤ F),
      source D C f d E ⋙ scalar D C hC E F h true ≅
        scalar D C hC E F h false ⋙ source D C f d F)
    (ha : ∀ (E F : Field D C) (h : E ≤ F) (K : Cat D C E Y),
      ((a E F h).hom.app K).hom = (sourceScalarComponent D C f d hC E F h K).hom) :
    (∀ (E : Field D C) (K : Cat D C E Y),
    (a E E le_rfl).hom.app K ≫
        (source D C f d E).map ((scalarUnit D C hC E false).hom.app K) =
      (scalarUnit D C hC E true).hom.app ((source D C f d E).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ (E F L : Field D C) (h : E ≤ F) (k : F ≤ L) (K : Cat D C E Y),
    (associator D C hC E F L h k true).hom.app ((source D C f d E).obj K) ≫
        (a E L (h.trans k)).hom.app K =
      (scalar D C hC F L k true).map ((a E F h).hom.app K) ≫
        (a F L k).hom.app ((scalar D C hC E F h false).obj K) ≫
        (source D C f d L).map ((associator D C hC E F L h k false).hom.app K)) ∧
    (∀ (E F : Field D C) (h : E ≤ F),
    ShiftCompatibility
      (source D C f d E ⋙ scalar D C hC E F h true)
      (scalar D C hC E F h false ⋙ source D C f d F)
      (composeShift (source D C f d E) (scalar D C hC E F h true)
        (sourceShift D C f d E) (scalarShift D C hC E F h true))
      (composeShift (scalar D C hC E F h false) (source D C f d F)
        (scalarShift D C hC E F h false) (sourceShift D C f d F)) (a E F h))
